summary.en: One strip of film: a black base with sprocket holes, frames a pitch apart, a variable-area optical track beside each, intertitles as frames; a fixed gate with four corner marks.
summary.zh: 一条胶片：带齿孔的黑色片基，按片距排列的画格，每格旁一条可变面积光学声轨，字幕卡也是一格；固定片门带四个角标。

fits: Real frames, titles and pages carried as one reel.

intent.en: Every picture is a frame on one strip, so order and count are physical.
intent.zh: 每个画面都是同一条胶片上的一格，顺序和数量都是实物。

content.en: Frames (images, cropped 16:9) and intertitle lines (≤ 3 words / 8 字).
content.zh: 画格（图片，裁成 16:9）和字幕卡（≤ 3 词 / 8 字）。

fits.zh: 把真实画格、标题和页面串成一卷。

notFor.zh: 多卷互不相关的胶片；竖屏视频。

en: Intertitles longer than the frame wrap badly: keep ≤ 16 chars / 8 字.
zh: 字幕卡比画格宽会很难看：≤ 16 字符 / 8 字。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
